verdict.rationale: The evidence pack references dropbox.com/plans multiple times but the actual snippets pulled from that page only mention unrelated feature bullets (file-transfer limits, deleted-file restore windows, PDF editing, AI integrations) — none state actual storage-quota sizes (e.g., 2TB/3TB), per-user monthly/annual pricing, or what happens when a user hits their storage cap. No evidence confirms the public page clearly publishes plan storage quotas, per-seat prices, or over-cap behavior.
